exposure: Ultrasound probability score for PAS (low, medium, high)
Clinical findings of PAS at birth
Ultrasound findings suggestive of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
outcome: Accuracy of prenatal ultrasound in diagnosing PAS
Concordance between ultrasound probability score and clinical grading of PAS at birth
cohort: 607 pregnant patients with at least one prior cesarean delivery
finding: While the study's ultrasound scoring system showed some correlation with clinical PAS grading, both prenatal ultrasound and clinical assessment at birth had difficulty accurately diagnosing the full spectrum of PAS, particularly at the extremes (grades 1, 4, and 5).
